definitions.legacy_composite_full_skin: same eight caps plus source-power cap and1Vpp ceiling
definitions.equal_current_and_power: no1Vpp ceiling; only named denominator is equalized
definitions.limits: frozen raw same-grid baseline numerical burdens and scalar cutoffs; not human safety/activation limits
